verdict.rationale: Forter ships its own Forter3DS SDK for iOS and Android, so it has a first-party 3DS capability for SCA flows. The evidence only covers SDK installation, though. Nothing shows 3DS being triggered selectively by regulatory requirement or risk, or exemptions being requested when safe. Missing for 10: documented risk-based 3DS triggering logic, SCA exemption request handling (e.g. TRA/low-value), EU/PSD2-specific routing documentation, and evidence of the conversion impact.

support.subject: As a developer, European traffic is routed intelligently through SCA — 3DS triggered when required or risky, exemptions requested when safe — to protect both compliance and conversion

citations.quote: The Forter3DS SDK offers flexible integration options, supporting both Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods.
Forter3DS SDK supports installation via Maven
